name: Plan Studio 2.0
author: Brett
description: A clean planning tree (plan-tree@1): plans, sections, steps, notes and lists nested inside each other to any depth, dragged to move or reorder at any level, every item with a full context menu (new inside, rename, edit, duplicate, move, delete with undo, export, send to the build orchestrator). Starts empty and nothing is synced into it: the to-do manager, the orchestrator, notes and Shipped features are reached only through links a person or a command adds. Every action is the same through REST, MCP (plugin commands), the CLI (tree.mjs) and AmberX voice (say). A sent plan reads its steps and their statuses from the builds store (never a copy): the orchestrator's steps replace the planning steps, marked From orchestrator, and check off live; when the build ships, the plan receives its shipped-manifest@1 (validated, every field kept; an invalid one is refused and flags the plan); the plan is locked until its build lands or is cancelled, and its context menu carries the orchestrator's actions. It is the one Plan Studio: it provides plans@1 (plans.mjs), so control@1 planner.plans, "put it in a plan for later" and the orchestrator read and write this tree.

items.title: The whole tree
items.description: Every item of Plan Studio 2.0 with the trash, progress and the allowed kinds, statuses, priorities, models and link types. A sent plan carries `live` (its build's state) and `locked`; the steps the orchestrator filed for it are listed under it with `origin: orchestrator`, read from the builds store.

items.title: The tree, nested
items.description: Items as nested rows (children inside their parent); `id` limits it to one branch.

items.title: One item
items.description: An item by id or by words in its title, with its path, children and ancestors.

items.title: Find items
items.description: Words → matching items, best first; each hit's `focus` opens it in the console (plan-studio-2.focus).

items.title: Export as Markdown or JSON
items.description: The whole tree or one branch as Markdown (`format=md`) or a plan-tree-export@1 JSON (`format=json`).

items.title: Add an item
items.description: A new plan, section, step, note, list or list item, inside `parent` (an id or words; empty = top level) at `index`.

items.title: Rename an item
items.description: Gives an item (by id or by words in its title) a new title. Its children, links and place in the tree stay as they are.

items.title: Edit an item
items.description: Change title, body, status, done, priority, tags, model, minutes, kind or collapsed.

items.title: Move an item
items.description: Into another item (`parent`, empty = top level) at `index`; everything under it moves along.

items.title: Move an item up or down
items.description: One place among its siblings: delta -1 (up) or 1 (down).

items.title: Indent an item
items.description: Into the sibling above it.

items.title: Outdent an item
items.description: Out to after its parent.

items.title: Duplicate an item
items.description: A copy of it and everything under it, right after it.

items.title: Delete an item (to the trash, undo brings it back)
items.description: Moves an item and everything under it to the trash; undo brings it back where it was.

items.title: Undo a delete
items.description: Brings the newest deleted item (or `trashId`) back where it was.

items.title: Link an item
items.description: An explicit link to a to-do, build, note, Shipped feature, another plan item or a URL. Never a sync.

items.title: Remove a link
items.description: Removes one link from an item. The linked to-do, build, note or page itself is not changed.

items.title: Collapse or expand
items.description: One item (`id`) or everything (`all: true`); `collapsed: false` expands.

items.title: Import items
items.description: A plan-tree-export@1 (or a list of items) under `parent`; ids are made new.

items.title: Send to the build orchestrator
items.description: The item becomes one Pipeline 2.0 build in Pending, never in the Queue (its open steps kept as planning notes; the orchestrator's splitting stage designs the build steps). One build is queued at a time: the orchestrator moves the next Pending build up when the queued one goes live. The answer carries `status: pending`. `preview: true` shows it without writing it.

items.title: Send as an emergency build
items.description: Brett only, from his own signed-in console session: the console token (this command through REST, MCP, the CLI or voice) is refused with 403. Like Send to the build orchestrator, and the build is tagged emergency: it skips the line, builds in the 2 emergency slots and lands first.

items.title: Orchestrator action on a sent plan or step
items.description: One action on a plan that was sent to the orchestrator, or on one of the steps the orchestrator filed for it: `action` is queue, hold, release, retry, rebuild, run-ci, land or cancel, or an answer to a clash (run-all, defer); `id` is the plan, anything inside it, or an orchestrator step row. The orchestrator decides whether it fits where the build is and answers with what happened, or with why not.

items.title: The build a plan was sent as
items.description: Read live from the builds store on every call, never from the plan tree: the build's number, its state with the plain status line, the waiting reason, the merge line (2nd to merge, waiting for build #41), who split it, a clash with its options, and every step with its unique id, split mark, triage model and status. `build` is null for a plan that was not sent.

items.title: Planning steps a send replaced
items.description: The planning steps that left an item when the orchestrator filed its own steps, kept on the item: one entry per build.

items.title: Bring replaced planning steps back
items.description: Puts the planning steps of a history entry (`entry`, the newest when empty) back into the item where they were. Refused while the item is locked by a sent build.

items.title: Sync sent plans with the builds store
items.description: Brings the tree in line with the builds store now: planning steps of a build that has been split move to the item's history; a build cancelled before it landed gives them back. Every read does this by itself.

items.title: Receive a shipped manifest
items.description: A shipped-manifest@1 for a plan that was sent to build: `build` (the build's manifest file) or `manifest`, optionally `id` (the plan). Validated with the shared validator: a valid one is stored on the plan with every field; an invalid one is refused with the field errors and flags the plan. The orchestrator's `shipped` event does this by itself.

items.title: The shipped manifest a plan carries
items.description: By plan id, words in its title, or the build it was sent as: the manifest, its summary, whether it landed complete, and the flag of a refused one.

items.title: Shipped manifest receipts
items.description: The last n receipts: build, plan, manifest id and rev, ok or refused with the reason.

items.title: Check shipped plans
items.description: Every sent build that shipped has its valid shipped-manifest@1 on its plan at the shipped rev; lists every problem.

items.title: Say a plan command
items.description: One spoken sentence (new plan X, add a step Y to X, rename X to Y, delete X, undo, move X into Y, mark X done, send X to the build orchestrator, find X, open X) → the matching change, with what to say back.

items.title: Clear everything (the trash too)
items.description: Deletes every item and empties the trash. This cannot be undone.
